==English==

===Etymology===
Compare various calques such as {{cog|es|en otras palabras}}, {{cog|pt|em outras palavras}}, {{cog|fr|en d'autres termes}} and {{cog|it|in altre parole}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{audio|en|en-au-in other words.ogg|a=AU}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-in other words.ogg|a=US}}

===Prepositional phrase===
{{en-prepphr|head=~word[s]}}

# {{lb|en|conjunctive|idiomatic}} [[stated|Stated]] or [[interpreted]] another way; phrased differently {{non-gloss|Used to introduce an [[explanation]], [[simplification]], or [[clarification]]}}.
#: {{ux|en|He has another appointment on Thursday. '''In other words''', I don't think he'll be attending your gathering.}}
#* {{quote-journal
|en
|year=1809
|month=July
|title=LINCOLNSHIRE.
|journal=w:The Universal Magazine
|series=New Series
|volume=XII
|issue=LXVIII
|issueurl=https://archive.org/details/sim_new-universal-magazine-or-miscellany_1809-07_12_68/
|page=78
|pageurl=https://archive.org/details/sim_new-universal-magazine-or-miscellany_1809-07_12_68/page/78/
|column=1
|text=On Tuesday evening he sent a message to the office of the Stamford paper, requesting that, as the "mountain could not wait upon Mahomet, Mahomet would go to the mountain,"—or, '''in other words''', that the printer would call upon him, and receive an order for executing some hand-bills announcing Mr. Lambert's arrival, and his desire to see company.}}
#* {{quote-web|en|date=February 9 2021|url=https://www.bbc.com/culture/article/20210208-is-tom-hanks-part-of-a-dying-breed-of-genuine-movie-stars|work=BBC|title=Is {{w|Tom Hanks}} part of a dying breed of genuine movie stars?
|author=Christina Newland|passage=Hanks is known as being an avid reader of history and biography, and seems to seek out stories which offer a certain optimism and humanism. '''In other words''', he plays – fundamentally – good people.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260906082934/https://www.bbc.com/culture/article/20210208-is-tom-hanks-part-of-a-dying-breed-of-genuine-movie-stars|archivedate=6 September 2026}}
